changelog:
- Brand Identity: Rebranded to Fokk Nox — an ultra-sleek, luxury midnight edition built for stealth, speed, and focus.
- Nox Midnight UI: Refined dark theme palette to deep obsidian (#07080C), starlight white typography, and subtle nebula violet glass pill accents.
- Viewport Insets & Webpage View: Fixed layout logic so the docked command bar never obscures webpage headers or navigation bar whether docked top or bottom.
- Smooth Webpage Expansion: Added smooth animated viewport transitions when the command bar collapses and expands on scroll.
- Stealth Incognito Mode: Guaranteed strict dark stealth theme for private tabs even when daylight mode is selected.
